psi_K_x_DE_motif.definition: Hydrophobic at -1 (I/L/V/M/F/W/Y/A), K at 0, any at +1, D/E at +2

key_false_negatives.SNCA_alpha_synuclein: 10/11 SUMO sites lack motif - all in disordered N-terminal region
key_false_negatives.ER_alpha: 6/6 SUMO sites lack motif - all in disordered regions

key_false_positives.IKKB_K147: Ub site with perfect psi-K-x-E motif

conclusion: SUM0 consensus motif is NOT a reliable discriminator. The motif is present at many SUMO sites but also absent at many real SUMO sites (disordered region SUMOylation). The Ub-only false positive rate is low (~3/28=11%) which supports asymmetric framework: motif roughly predicts where SUMO CAN act, but Ub acts everywhere regardless.
